description: Search full Web of Science records, cited references, related documents, and citation reports through the paid Clarivate Expanded API.

auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Web of Science API key with a paid Expanded API subscription, sent in the X-ApiKey header. Register an application and request Expanded access in the official Clarivate Developer Portal: https://developer.clarivate.com/apis/wos

actions.name: get_citation_report
actions.description: Generate citation totals, self-citation-adjusted metrics, yearly counts, and h-index for a Web of Science query.

query.description: The Web of Science advanced query to analyze.

database.description: The Web of Science database to search. WOS searches the Core Collection and WOK searches all entitled databases. Defaults to WOS.

language.description: The search language code. WOS supports en, while entitled regional databases may support other languages.

edition.description: The collection and edition expression, such as WOS+SCI, with multiple editions separated by commas.

publishTimeSpan.description: The publication date range in YYYY-MM-DD+YYYY-MM-DD form.

loadTimeSpan.description: The symbolic database load time span, such as 5D, 30W, 10M, or 8Y.

createdTimeSpan.description: The record creation date range in YYYY-MM-DD+YYYY-MM-DD form.

modifiedTimeSpan.description: The record modification date range in YYYY-MM-DD+YYYY-MM-DD form.

timesCitedModifiedTimeSpan.description: The times-cited modification date range in YYYY-MM-DD+YYYY-MM-DD form.

reportLevels.description: The collection levels to include in the citation report. Defaults to WOS.

startYear.description: The first citing year to include, from 1900 onward.

endYear.description: The last citing year to include, from 1900 onward.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for generating a citation report from a Web of Science query.

queryId.description: The temporary Web of Science query identifier.

anyOf.description: The number of records searched when available.

recordsSearched.description: The number of records searched when available.

anyOf.description: The number of matching records when available.

recordsFound.description: The number of matching records when available.

queryMetadata.description: Metadata for the query used to generate the report.

anyOf.description: The collection level represented by this report.

reportLevel.description: The collection level represented by this report.

anyOf.description: The total times-cited value when available.

timesCited.description: The total times-cited value when available.

anyOf.description: The times-cited value excluding self-citations when available.

timesCitedSansSelf.description: The times-cited value excluding self-citations when available.

anyOf.description: The number of citing items excluding self-citations when available.

citingItemsSansSelf.description: The number of citing items excluding self-citations when available.

anyOf.description: The de-duplicated times-cited value when available.

dedupedTimesCited.description: The de-duplicated times-cited value when available.

anyOf.description: The average citations per item when available.

averagePerItem.description: The average citations per item when available.

anyOf.description: The average citations per year when available.

averagePerYear.description: The average citations per year when available.

anyOf.description: The h-index for the query result when available.

hIndex.description: The h-index for the query result when available.

anyOf.description: The citation counts grouped by citing year when available.

citingYears.description: The citation counts grouped by citing year when available.

items.description: A normalized citation report for one report level.

reports.description: The citation reports returned for the requested levels.

raw.description: The raw query and citation report responses.

outputSchema.description: The citation report generated for the query.
